results.operating_point: builtin-heuristic native verdict (analyze_text); no score threshold
results.method: Independent reproduction: cache files read directly as JSONL; content dedup and near-duplicate grouping re-derived from scratch; partition re-derived row by row from sha256(group_key) mod 10; detector re-run on the 861 final-test labelled rows; Wilson/AUROC (pairwise Mann-Whitney)/AUPRC/TPR@FPR/cluster-bootstrap recomputed from scratch with independent implementations, plus the threshold sensitivity on final-test human rows. No tuning on the final holdout.

If it is the U1 row, the -0.02 fragility (one row flips at 0.66) is NOT independent confirmation on fresh data — it is that one known row.
